question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is Vocifirous.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of 'Vocifirous' according to the English dictionary is '**V****ociferous**'.
 
• The word 'Vociferous' means '**expressing your opinions or feelings in a loud and confident way (अपनी भावनाओं या विचारों को ज़ोरदार और गंभीर ढंग से व्‍यक्त करते हुए)**'.

 

*​Hence, the most appropriate answer is 'Vocifirous'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's understand the meaning of other options.

 
 
• **Affliction**- a cause of persistent pain or distress (दुख, वेदना, मनस्‍ताप).
 
• **Episcopal**- of a bishop or bishops (बिशप का).
 
• **Innocuous**- not meant to cause harm or upset somebody (अहानिकर, सीधा-सादा).
